questions.text: बाज़ार मूल्य पर शुद्ध मूल्य वृद्धि (NVA_MP) का मूल्य प्राप्त करने के लिए, बाज़ार मूल्य पर सकल वर्धित मूल्य (GVA_MP) में/में से _______ को _______ जाना चाहिए। (रिक्त स्थानों की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: To arrive at the value of Net Value Added at Market Price (NVA_MP), _______ must be _______ to/from Gross Value Added at Market Price (GVA_MP). (Choose the correct option to fill in the blanks)
questions.solution: Option (B) is correct. To move from Gross to Net, we must subtract depreciation (consumption of fixed capital). Therefore, to get NVA_MP from GVA_MP, depreciation must be subtracted.

questions.text: पहचान कीजिए कि, निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक सार्वजनिक वस्तु को वर्णित नहीं करता है।
questions.text_english: Identify, which of the following does not represent a public good.

options.A: सरकार द्वारा उपलब्ध कराए गए निःशुल्क टीके (वैक्सीन)
options.C: किसी व्यक्ति द्वारा रेलवे टिकट का क्रय
options.D: किसी शहर की नगरपालिका द्वारा स्थापित स्ट्रीट लाइट (Street light)

options_english.A: Free vaccines provided by the government
options_english.B: Defence services provided by the military
options_english.C: Purchase of railway ticket by an individual
options_english.D: Street light installed by a city municipality

questions.solution: Option (C) is correct. A public good is non-rivalrous and non-excludable. A railway ticket is a private good because it is excludable (only those who buy it can use the service) and rivalrous (one ticket consumed leaves fewer seats for others).

questions.text: विदेशी विनिमय दर निर्धारण में माँग व पूर्ति की बाज़ार शक्तियाँ _______ विनिमय दर प्रणाली के अंतर्गत सक्रिय रूप से परस्पर क्रिया करती हैं। (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: Market forces of demand and supply, actively interact under _______ exchange rate system to determine the foreign exchange rate. (Choose the correct option to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: Option (B) is correct. In a flexible exchange rate system, the exchange rate is determined solely by the market forces of demand and supply for foreign currency, without direct government intervention.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए: कथन 1: अवस्फीतिकारी अंतराल के दौरान, किसी राष्ट्र का केन्द्रीय बैंक रेपो (Repo) दर में वृद्धि कर सकता है। कथन 2: सरकार खुले बाज़ार में सरकारी प्रतिभूतियों (G-Sec) के क्रय द्वारा अवस्फीतिकारी अंतराल को कम कर सकती है। दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully: Statement 1: During deflationary gap, the Central Bank of a country may increase the repo rate. Statement 2: The government can reduce the deflationary gap by purchasing Government Securities (G-Sec) in the open market. In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Option (B) is correct. Statement 1 is false because during a deflationary gap, the Central Bank decreases the repo rate to encourage borrowing and investment. Statement 2 is true because the Central Bank (or government policy) purchasing securities injects liquidity, thus reducing the deflationary gap.

questions.text: कीन्स के सिद्धांत के अंतर्गत, 'संदर्भ रेखा' (Reference line) मूल बिंदु से _______ कोण पर खींची जाने वाली एक सीधी रेखा है। (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: Under the Keynesian theory, 'Reference Line' is a straight line passing through the origin drawn at an angle of _______. (Choose the correct option to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: Option (B) is correct. The 45-degree line is used in Keynesian models as the reference line where Aggregate Supply equals Aggregate Income, because at every point on this line, the distance from the horizontal axis equals the distance from the vertical axis.

questions.text: 2023 - 24 के केन्द्रीय बज़ट में प्रस्तुत आँकड़ों के अनुसार, सरकार की कुल प्राप्तियाँ (ऋण के अतिरिक्त) तथा कुल व्यय क्रमशः ₹ 20 लाख करोड़ तथा ₹ 45 लाख करोड़ अनुमानित हैं। अतः _______ घाटे का मूल्य ₹ 25 लाख करोड़ होगा। (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: According to the data presented in the Union Budget 2023-24, the total receipts of the government (other than borrowings), and the total expenditure are estimated as ₹ 20 lakh crore and ₹ 45 lakh crore respectively. Therefore, the value of _______ deficit would be ₹ 25 lakh crore. (Choose the correct option to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: Option (B) is correct. Fiscal deficit is equal to total expenditure minus total receipts (excluding borrowings). Here, 45 - 20 = 25 lakh crore, which represents the fiscal deficit.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए: कथन 1: सीमांत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति (MPC) प्रति आय इकाई उपभोग को प्रदर्शित करता है। कथन 2: जैसे-जैसे किसी देश की राष्ट्रीय आय में वृद्धि होती है, उपभोग में आनुपातिक वृद्धि सदैव आय में वृद्धि से अधिक होती है। दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully: Statement 1: Marginal Propensity to Consume (MPC) exhibits the consumption per unit of income. Statement 2: As the national income of a country rises, the proportionate increase in the consumption is always more than the increase in the income. In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Option (A) is correct. Statement 1 is true as MPC is the change in consumption due to change in income. Statement 2 is false because Keynes' Psychological Law of Consumption suggests that while consumption increases as income rises, it does not increase proportionally more than income (MPC is typically less than 1).

questions.text: किसी द्वि-क्षेत्रीय अर्थव्यवस्था में, _______ व _______ को जोड़कर समग्र पूर्ति का निर्धारण किया जा सकता है। (रिक्त स्थानों की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: In a two-sector economy, Aggregate Supply can be determined by adding _______ and _______. (Choose the correct option to fill in the blanks)
questions.solution: Option (C) is correct. In a simple two-sector model, national income is either consumed (C) or saved (S). Thus, Aggregate Supply (Y) = C + S.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए: कथन 1: किसी सरकार के लिए विदेशी सहायता (Foreign aids) पूँजीगत प्राप्तियाँ होती हैं। कथन 2: विनिवेश से सरकार की परिसम्पत्तियों में कमी आ सकती है। दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully: Statement 1: Foreign aids are the capital receipts for the government. Statement 2: Disinvestments may lead to a decrease in the assets of the government. In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Option (B) is correct. Statement 1 is false because foreign aid is typically considered a revenue receipt if it is a grant, or a capital receipt only if it is a loan (it depends on nature, but generally, aid is not automatically capital receipt). Statement 2 is true as disinvestment involves selling equity of PSUs, reducing the government's assets.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से उस स्थिति को पहचानिए, जो किसी राष्ट्र के भुगतान संतुलन (BOP) खाते में चालू खाते अधिशेष (CAS) को इंगित करती है।
questions.text_english: From the following, identify the situation which indicates the Current Account Surplus (CAS) in Balance of Payments (BOP) account of a nation.

options.A: चालू खाते की प्राप्तियों का चालू खाते के भुगतानों पर आधिक्य
options.B: चालू खाते की प्राप्तियों व चालू खाते के भुगतानों में समानता
options.C: चालू खाते के भुगतानों का चालू खाते की प्राप्तियों पर आधिक्य
options.D: चालू खाते के भुगतानों का पूँजी खाते की प्राप्तियों पर आधिक्य

options_english.A: Excess of receipts on current account over the payments on current account.
options_english.B: Equality of receipts on current account and payments on current account.
options_english.C: Excess of payments on current account over receipts on current account.
options_english.D: Excess of payments on current account over receipts on capital account.

questions.solution: Option (A) is correct. A surplus in the current account of the Balance of Payments occurs when the total value of current account receipts (export of goods, services, transfers) exceeds the total value of current account payments (import of goods, services, transfers).

questions.text: (क) आय विधि के अंतर्गत, राष्ट्रीय आय के आकलन से संबंधित चरणों का उल्लेख कीजिए। अथवा (ख) निम्नलिखित काल्पनिक आँकड़ों के आधार पर, 2020-21 को आधार वर्ष मानते हुए, वर्ष 2022-23 में वास्तविक सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) में प्रतिशत परिवर्तन की गणना कीजिए। (सभी आँकड़े ₹ करोड़ में)
questions.text_english: (a) State the steps pertaining to the estimation of National Income, under the Income Method. OR (b) On the basis of the following hypothetical data, calculate the percentage change in Real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) in the year 2022-23, using 2020-21 as the base year. (All figures in ₹ crore)

sub_questions.text: आय विधि के अंतर्गत, राष्ट्रीय आय के आकलन से संबंधित चरणों का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State the steps pertaining to the estimation of National Income, under the Income Method.

key_points: Identify and classify production units into primary, secondary, and tertiary sectors.
Estimate factor income (compensation of employees, operating surplus, mixed income) generated in each sector.
Sum the factor incomes to get Net Domestic Product at factor cost (NDP_FC).
Add Net Factor Income from Abroad (NFIA) to NDP_FC to arrive at National Income (NNP_FC).

sub_questions.solution: The first step in the Income Method is to identify and classify all producing enterprises into primary, secondary, and tertiary sectors. The second step involves estimating factor incomes generated by each sector, which include compensation of employees, operating surplus, and mixed income. The third step is to calculate domestic income (NDP at Factor Cost) by summing these incomes. Finally, National Income (NNP at Factor Cost) is calculated by adding Net Factor Income from Abroad to the domestic income.

questions.solution: This question provides an internal choice. For part (a), the steps are provided in the sub-question. For part (b), the real GDP for 2020-21 is 5000 and for 2022-23 is 6000. Percentage change = ((6000-5000)/5000) * 100 = 20%.

questions.text: "भारत के आर्थिक सर्वेक्षण 2022-23 के अनुसार, भू-राजनीतिक संघर्ष के प्रादुर्भाव के कारण उर्वरक व ईंधन के अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मूल्यों में वृद्धि हुई थी। अतः लोगों की सहायता सुनिश्चित करने के लिए ईंधन व उर्वरक उपदान की आवश्यकता में बढ़ोतरी हुई थी।" दिए गए गद्य के आधार पर, सरकार के इंगित बजट उद्देश्य की पहचान व व्याख्या कीजिए।
questions.text_english: "As per the Economic Survey of India 2022–23, due to the outbreak of geopolitical conflict, international prices of fertilizers and fuel increased. Consequently, the requirement for higher fuel and fertilizer subsidies increased to ensure support to people." On the basis of the given text, identify and explain the indicated objective of the government budget.

key_points: Identification of objective: Redistribution of income and wealth.
Explanation: Providing subsidies to help the people, especially the vulnerable sections, reduces their cost of living.
Significance: This helps in narrowing the inequality gap and ensuring social welfare.

questions.solution: The indicated objective of the government budget is the redistribution of income and wealth. By providing subsidies on essential items like fuel and fertilizer, the government reduces the financial burden on the public, particularly those who are more vulnerable. This policy aims to ensure that the basic needs of the people are met, which directly contributes to the goal of reducing economic inequality and promoting social justice within the country.

questions.text: (क) "2023-24 के दौरान, US $ 70.9 Bn के प्रत्यक्ष विदेशी निवेश (FDI) अंतर्वाह व US $ 32.4 Bn के शुद्ध विदेशी पोर्टफोलियो निवेश (FPI) अंतर्वाह के साथ भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था में तीव्र परिवर्तन का अनुभव किया गया है।" (i) उपर्युक्त आर्थिक चरों के मध्य अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए। (ii) भुगतान संतुलन के किस खाते में उपर्युक्त मदों को दर्ज किया जाएगा व क्यों ? अथवा (ख) व्याख्या कीजिए कि, स्वायत्त लेन-देन किस प्रकार समायोजन लेन-देन से भिन्न होते हैं।
questions.text_english: (a) "The Indian economy has witnessed a sharp turnaround during 2023–24 with Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) inflows of US $70.9 Bn and net Foreign Portfolio Investment (FPI) inflows of US $32.4 Bn." (i) Distinguish between the above-mentioned economic variables. (ii) In which account of the Balance of Payments will the given variables be recorded and why? OR (b) Explain how autonomous transactions differ from accommodating transactions.

sub_questions.text: उपर्युक्त आर्थिक चरों के मध्य अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Distinguish between the above mentioned economic variables.

key_points: FDI involves direct investment in physical assets and management control.
FPI involves investment in financial assets (stocks/bonds) without direct management control.

sub_questions.solution: Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) refers to an investment made by a foreign firm to create a lasting interest in a domestic enterprise, which often includes managerial control. In contrast, Foreign Portfolio Investment (FPI) involves the purchase of financial assets like stocks and bonds by foreign investors to earn returns, but it does not grant them any management control over the domestic company.

sub_questions.text: भुगतान संतुलन के किस खाते में उपर्युक्त मदों को दर्ज किया जाएगा व क्यों ?
sub_questions.text_english: In which account of Balance of Payments will the given variables be entered and why?

key_points: Recorded in Capital Account of BOP.
Reason: These transactions affect the assets and liabilities of the nation in relation to the rest of the world.

sub_questions.solution: These items are recorded in the Capital Account of the Balance of Payments. They are classified there because they result in a change in the country's foreign assets and liabilities, representing the movement of capital into or out of the Indian economy.

questions.solution: This is a composite question on BOP. FDI and FPI are critical capital account transactions. Autonomous transactions are driven by profit motives, while accommodating transactions are meant to balance the BOP deficit/surplus.

questions.text: मान लीजिए कि, दो काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्थाओं A व B के लिए, सीमांत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति (MPC) का मान क्रमश: 0-8 व 0-6 है। दोनों अर्थव्यस्थाओं के लिए, स्वायत्त उपभोग (C_bar) = ₹ 400 करोड़ तथा निवेश व्यय (I) = ₹ 2,000 करोड़ है। निम्नलिखित की गणना कीजिए: (क) अर्थव्यवस्था A के लिए आय का सम स्तर (Break-even level)। (ख) अर्थव्यवस्था B के लिए आय का संतुलन स्तर।
questions.text_english: Suppose for two imaginary economies A and B, the value of Marginal Propensity to Consume (MPC) stands at 0-8 and 0.6 respectively. For both the economies, Autonomous Consumption (C_bar) = ₹ 400 crore and Investment Expenditure (I) = ₹ 2,000 crore. Calculate the following: (a) Break-even level of income for Economy A. (b) Equilibrium level of income for Economy B.

sub_questions.text: अर्थव्यवस्था A के लिए आय का सम स्तर (Break-even level)।
sub_questions.text_english: Break-even level of income for Economy A.

key_points: Break-even: Consumption = Income (Y = C).

sub_questions.solution: At the break-even level of income, consumption equals income (Y = C). Given C_bar = 400 and MPC = 0.8, the consumption function is C = 400 + 0.8Y. Setting Y = C, we get Y = 400 + 0.8Y, which simplifies to 0.2Y = 400. Therefore, Y = 2,000 crore.

sub_questions.text: अर्थव्यवस्था B के लिए आय का संतुलन स्तर।
sub_questions.text_english: Equilibrium level of income for Economy B.

key_points: Equilibrium: Y = C + I.

sub_questions.solution: The equilibrium level of income in a two-sector economy is where Aggregate Demand equals Aggregate Supply (Y = C + I). Given C_bar = 400, MPC = 0.6, and I = 2,000, we have Y = 400 + 0.6Y + 2,000. This simplifies to 0.4Y = 2,400. Thus, Y = 6,000 crore.

questions.solution: The calculation shows the break-even point for Economy A at 2,000 crore and equilibrium for Economy B at 6,000 crore based on standard Keynesian models.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित गद्य का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए: एक अर्थव्यवस्था में, समग्र माँग में उल्लेखनीय कमी ने, देश के भविष्य की विकास संभावनाओं के बारे में चिंताएँ उत्पन्न कर दी हैं। यह आर्थिक मंदी, गृहस्थों के विश्वास में वृद्धि करने तथा आर्थिक गतिविधि को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए रणनीतिक उपायों की तत्काल आवश्यकता को रेखांकित करती है। उपर्युक्त गद्य तथा सामान्य ज्ञान के आधार पर, उन उपायों की व्याख्या कीजिए जिन्हें सरकार निर्दिष्ट स्थिति को स्थिर करने के लिए कर सकती है।
questions.text_english: Read the following text carefully: In an economy, a significant reduction in Aggregate demand raised concerns about future growth prospects of the country. This economic downturn underscores the urgent need for strategic measures to boost confidence of households and stimulate economic activities. Based on the above text and common understanding, explain the measures which the government may take to stabilise the indicated situation.

key_points: Fiscal policy: Increase government expenditure to boost demand.
Tax cuts: Reduce personal/corporate taxes to increase disposable income and investment.
Monetary measures: Central Bank lowering interest rates to encourage borrowing.
Public works: Investing in infrastructure to create employment and stimulate economic activity.

questions.solution: To address the economic downturn caused by deficient demand, the government can adopt expansionary fiscal policy. This involves increasing government expenditure on public infrastructure and welfare projects, which directly adds to the total demand. Additionally, the government can reduce taxes, which increases the disposable income of households and encourages consumption. Monetary policy measures, implemented by the Central Bank, such as reducing interest rates, can make credit cheaper for businesses and households, thereby boosting investment and consumption and stabilizing the economic situation.

questions.text: (क) "किसी राष्ट्र में, नियमित आर्थिक संचालन, सुचारु आर्थिक गतिविधियाँ लेनदेन को सुविधाजनक बनाने के लिए विनिमय के एक स्थिर माध्यम पर निर्भर करता है।" मुद्रा के निर्दिष्ट कार्य पर संक्षेप में चर्चा कीजिए। (ख) मुद्रा आपूर्ति के M1 माप का अर्थ व घटकों का उल्लेख कीजिए। (ग) साख गुणक की गणना करने का सूत्र लिखिए।
questions.text_english: (a) "In a country, routine economic operations rely on a stable medium to facilitate transactions for maintaining smooth economic activities." Briefly discuss the indicated function of money. (b) State the meaning and components of M1 measure of money supply. (c) State the formula to compute the credit multiplier.

sub_questions.text: मुद्रा के निर्दिष्ट कार्य पर संक्षेप में चर्चा कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Discuss briefly the indicated function of money.

key_points: Function is Medium of Exchange.
Money eliminates the double coincidence of wants problem inherent in barter system.
It facilitates easy purchase and sale of goods and services.

sub_questions.solution: The indicated function of money is the 'medium of exchange'. Money serves as an intermediary to facilitate the exchange of goods and services, eliminating the need for a double coincidence of wants, which is a major drawback of the barter system. It simplifies transactions and acts as an acceptable universal payment mechanism in the economy, thus supporting smooth economic operations.

sub_questions.text: मुद्रा आपूर्ति के M1 माप का अर्थ व घटकों का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State the meaning and components of M1 measure of money supply.

key_points: Meaning: M1 is the most liquid measure of money supply.
Components: C (Currency held by public) + DD (Demand Deposits with banks).

sub_questions.solution: M1 is the narrowest and most liquid measure of money supply in an economy. Its components include currency held by the public in the form of coins and notes, and demand deposits held by the public with commercial banks, which are withdrawable on demand by check or other means.

sub_questions.text: साख गुणक की गणना करने का सूत्र लिखिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State the formula to compute Credit Multiplier.

key_points: Credit Multiplier = 1 / LRR (Legal Reserve Ratio).

sub_questions.solution: The formula to compute the Credit Multiplier is: Credit Multiplier = 1 / LRR, where LRR stands for the Legal Reserve Ratio.

questions.solution: This question covers core monetary economics concepts including functions of money, money supply components, and credit creation.

questions.text:
(क) (i) मान लीजिए कि एक काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्था में केवल तीन फर्में A, B और C हैं। फर्म A ने फर्म B को ₹2,000 तथा फर्म C को ₹1,200 के मूल्य का माल विक्रय किया। फर्म B ने फर्म A को ₹1,100 तथा फर्म C को ₹3,500 के मूल्य का माल विक्रय किया। फर्म C ने गृहस्थों को ₹5,700 के मूल्य के माल का अंतिम उपभोग के लिए विक्रय किया। मूल्यह्रास को ₹120 मानते हुए, बाज़ार मूल्य पर शुद्ध घरेलू उत्पाद (NDP_MP) का मूल्य अनुमानित कीजिए। (ii) किसी राष्ट्र में उच्च गुणवत्तापूर्ण शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाले 2,000 नए विद्यालयों के निर्माण से अर्थव्यवस्था में सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) व कल्याण पर संभावित प्रभावों की व्याख्या कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) (i) "सभी उपभोग वस्तुएँ टिकाऊ प्रकृति की होती हैं।" वैध तर्क से दिए गए कथन का समर्थन अथवा खंडन कीजिए। (ii) दिए गए आँकड़ों के आधार पर, राष्ट्रीय आय (NNP_FC) के मूल्य का अनुमान लगाइए।
questions.text_english:
(a) (i) Suppose there are only three firms in a hypothetical economy, namely A, B and C. Firm A sold goods worth ₹2,000 to Firm B and ₹1,200 to Firm C. Firm B sold goods worth ₹1,100 to Firm A and ₹3,500 to Firm C. Firm C sold goods worth ₹5,700 to households for final consumption. Estimate the value of Net Domestic Product at Market Price (NDP_MP), assuming depreciation is ₹120. (ii) Explain the likely impact of constructing 2,000 new schools providing high-quality education on Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and welfare in an economy.
OR
(b) (i) "All consumption goods are durable in nature." Defend or refute the given statement with valid reasoning. (ii) On the basis of the given data, estimate the value of National Income (NNP_FC).

key_points: Value Added by Firm A = (Sales to B + C) = 2000 + 1200 = 3200.
Value Added by Firm B = (Sales to A + C) = 1100 + 3500 = 4600.
Value Added by Firm C = (Sales to Households) = 5700.
NDP_MP = GDP_MP - Depreciation = 13500 - 120 = 13380.

sub_questions.solution: Firm A's Value Added = (2000 + 1200) = 3200. Firm B's Value Added = (1100 + 3500) = 4600. Firm C's Value Added = 5700. GDP_MP = 3200 + 4600 + 5700 = 13500. NDP_MP = GDP_MP - Depreciation = 13500 - 120 = 13380. So, NDP_MP is ₹ 13,380.

key_points: GDP: Positive impact as investment/construction increases GDP.
Welfare: Positive impact as human capital formation improves education, productivity, and life quality.

sub_questions.solution: The construction of 2,000 new schools will lead to an increase in Gross Domestic Product (GDP) due to government spending on infrastructure and the construction industry. Furthermore, it will positively impact economic welfare by fostering human capital formation, which enhances the quality of education, improves future labour productivity, and increases the overall standard of living for the population.

questions.solution: This question tests both calculation of national income using the value-added method and understanding of the relationship between GDP, human capital formation, and social welfare.

questions.text: एक विशिष्ट फसल के स्थान पर, विभिन्न प्रकार की फसलों का उत्पादन _______ के विविधीकरण के रूप में जाना जाता है। (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: Production of diverse varieties of crops, rather than one specialised crop, is known as diversification of _______. (Choose the correct option to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: Option (A) is correct. Diversification of crops refers to the practice of shifting from a single crop system (monoculture) to the production of diverse varieties of crops to reduce risk and increase income.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों - अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) का अध्ययन कीजिए। नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए: अभिकथन (A): लोग श्रम व अन्य बाज़ारों (जैसे कि शिक्षा व स्वास्थ्य) से संबंधित सूचना प्राप्त करने के लिए व्यय करते हैं। कारण (R): मानव पूँजी स्टॉक के कुशलतम प्रयोग के लिए सूचना पर व्यय आवश्यक है।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements - Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct option from the options given below: Assertion (A): People spend to acquire information related to labour and other markets (like, education and health). Reason (R): Expenditure on information is necessary for efficient utilisation of the human capital stock.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Option (A) is correct. Expenditure on information regarding labour markets is a critical form of human capital investment because individuals need this information to make informed decisions about their skills, education, and career paths, thereby ensuring the efficient use of their human capital.

questions.text: स्वतंत्रता उपरांत युग में, भारत के नीति निर्माताओं ने प्रथम _______ पंचवर्षीय योजनाओं के लिए 'आत्मनिर्भरता' पर जोर दिया था। (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: In the post-independence era, the policy makers of India emphasised on 'self-reliance' for the first _______ Five Year Plans. (Choose the correct option to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: Option (B) is correct. Self-reliance was a major goal of Indian economic planning for the first seven Five Year Plans, which emphasized domestic production to reduce dependency on foreign imports.

questions.text: पहचान कीजिए कि, भारत में ग्रामीण बैकिंग प्रणाली के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन असत्य है ?
questions.text_english: Identify, which of the following statements is incorrect about the Rural Banking system in India.

options.A: भारत में ग्रामीण बैंकिंग प्रणाली में बहु-ऐजेंसी संस्थानों का एक समूह सम्मिलित है।
options.B: स्वतंत्रता उपरांत अवधि में, भारत में एक सुचारु रूप से संरचित ग्रामीण बैंकिंग प्रणाली का निर्माण किया गया था।
options.C: क्षेत्रीय ग्रामीण बैंक, सहकारी व भूमि विकास बैंक भारत में ग्रामीण बैंकिंग प्रणाली के घटक हैं।
options.D: भारत में ग्रामीण बैंकिंग प्रणाली भारतीय स्टेट बैंक के मार्गदर्शन, निर्देशन व पर्यवेक्षण के अंतर्गत कार्य करती है।

options_english.A: The Rural Banking system in India consists of a set of multi-agency institutions.
options_english.B: In the post-independence period, a well-structured Rural Banking system was formulated in India.
options_english.C: Regional Rural Banks, Cooperative and Land Development Banks are components of the Rural Banking system in India.
options_english.D: The Rural Banking system in India works under the guidance, instruction and supervision of the State Bank of India.

questions.solution: Option (D) is correct (as the incorrect statement). The rural banking system in India is primarily supervised and regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and NABARD, not solely by the State Bank of India.

questions.text: पहचान कीजिए कि, पर्यावरण के कार्यों के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन असत्य है ?
questions.text_english: Identify, which of the following statements is incorrect about the functions of environment.

options.B: पर्यावरण अपव्यय को अवशोषित करता है।
options.C: पर्यावरण जीवन का पोषण करता है।
options.D: पर्यावरण जीवन की गुणवत्ता का क्षय करता है।

questions.solution: Option (D) is correct (as the incorrect statement). The environment inherently supports life and provides resources; it does not intentionally deteriorate the quality of life, although human activity often causes environmental degradation which in turn impacts quality of life.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों – अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) का अध्ययन कीजिए। नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए: अभिकथन (A): 1991 में प्रारंभ किए गए वित्तीय क्षेत्र सुधारों के अंतर्गत, बैंकों में विदेशी निवेश की सीमा लगभग 74% तक बढ़ा दी गई थी। कारण (R): 1991 के उपरांत, विदेशी संस्थागत निवेशकों (FIIs) को भारतीय वित्तीय बाज़ारों में निवेश करने की अनुमति दे दी गई थी।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements - Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct alternative from the options given below: Assertion (A): Under the financial sector reforms introduced in 1991, foreign investment limit in banks was raised up to around 74%. Reason (R): Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were allowed to invest in Indian financial markets, post-1991.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Option (B) is correct. While both statements are factual regarding the post-1991 reforms, the reason (FIIs being allowed to invest) is not the direct causal explanation for the specific increase in the foreign investment limit in banks to 74% (which was a policy decision over time).

questions.text: "मान लीजिए कि, एक काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्था वास्तविक सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) में वृद्धि की स्थिति का अनुभव कर रही है, जबकि अर्थव्यवस्था में रोज़गार के अवसरों में पर्याप्त वृद्धि नहीं हो रही है।" ऐसी स्थिति को, आर्थिक भाषा शैली में _______ वृद्धि कहा जाता है। (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: "Suppose an imaginary economy is experiencing a situation of rise in Real Gross Domestic Product (GDP), without any corresponding adequate rise in employment opportunities in the economy." In economic parlance, such a situation is termed as _______ growth. (Choose the correct option to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: Option (D) is correct. A situation where GDP increases but employment does not grow proportionately is called 'Jobless Growth'.
questions.chapter: Employment: Growth, Informalisation and Other Issues

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए: कथन 1: ब्रिटिश नीतियों के कारण भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था के द्वितीयक व तृतीयक क्षेत्रों में प्रचुर मात्रा में रोज़गार सृजन हुआ था। कथन 2: औपनिवेशिक सरकार के संरचनात्मक ढाँचे के विकास का वास्तविक उद्देश्य भारतीय हितों को लाभान्वित करना था। दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully: Statement 1: The British policies led to huge employment generation in the secondary and tertiary sectors of the Indian Economy. Statement 2: The real motive of the colonial government's infrastructural development was to benefit interests of India. In the light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Option (D) is correct. Both statements are false. British policies led to de-industrialization and the decline of traditional sectors rather than employment generation. The motive for infrastructural development (like railways) was to serve British economic interests, not Indian ones.
questions.chapter: Indian Economy on the Eve of Independence

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए: कथन 1: सरकार द्वारा न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य (MSP) पर किए गए खाद्यान्न के क्रय को बफ़र स्टॉक के रूप में रखा जाता है। कथन 2: न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य (MSP) कृषि उत्पाद मूल्यों में किसी भी तीव्र गिरावट के विरुद्ध, कृषकों को सुरक्षा प्रदान करता है। दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully: Statement 1: The purchase of food grains, made by the government on the Minimum Support Price (MSP), is maintained as buffer stock. Statement 2: Minimum Support Price (MSP) safeguards the farmers against any sharp fall in farm product prices. In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Option (C) is correct. Both statements are true. Buffer stocks are maintained to ensure food security, and MSP provides a price floor to protect farmers' incomes from volatile market price drops.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित चित्र का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए: [Image: Mixed Economic System, Green Revolution, ?] निम्नलिखित में से उस सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए, जो 1947 की अवधि के उपरांत भारत व पाकिस्तान की नीतियों में समानताओं को इंगित करता है:
questions.text_english: Study the following image carefully: [Image: Mixed Economic System, Green Revolution, ?] From the following, choose the correct option which indicates similarities in the policies of India and Pakistan, in the post-1947 period:
questions.solution: Option (C) is correct. Both India and Pakistan adopted import substitution industrialization strategies in the post-independence period to reduce reliance on foreign manufactured goods and foster domestic industries.

questions.text: (क) "भारत में ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक शासन ने व्यवस्थित आर्थिक शोषण किया था, जिसमें ब्रिटेन को लाभ पहुँचाने के लिए भारत के संसाधनों व सम्पत्ति का दोहन सम्मिलित था।" वैध स्पष्टीकरण द्वारा दिए गए कथन की पुष्टि कीजिए। अथवा (ख) "1991 के सुधारों के अंतर्गत भारत की विनिवेश नीति में सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के उपक्रमों (PSUs) में सरकार की हिस्सेदारी की बिक्री सम्मिलित थी।" इस निर्णय को लेने के पीछे सरकार के तर्क स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english: (a) "British colonial rule in India executed systematic economic exploitation involving the extraction of India's resources and wealth to benefit Britain." Justify the given statement with valid explanation. OR (b) "The disinvestment policy under the 1991 reforms in India involved the sale of part of the government's stake in Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)." Explain the rationale behind this decision taken by the government.

key_points: For (a): Colonial rule reduced India to a supplier of raw materials and importer of British finished goods.
For (a): Systematic drain of wealth to finance Britain's industrialization.
For (b): Rationale: Improve financial health, increase efficiency through private participation, reduce fiscal deficit.

questions.solution: For part (a), the British colonial rule systematically exploited India by transforming it into a mere supplier of cheap raw materials for British factories and a captive market for their finished goods. This led to the drain of wealth and the collapse of India's domestic handicraft industries, effectively financing the British Industrial Revolution at the expense of Indian development. For part (b), the government's rationale for disinvestment included improving the operational efficiency and financial performance of PSUs, reducing the fiscal burden on the exchequer, and generating non-tax revenue to help manage the fiscal deficit.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित आँकड़ों का उपयोग करते हुए, सकल वर्धित मूल्य (GVA) में भारत व पाकिस्तान के क्षेत्रीय योगदान का विश्लेषण कीजिए। [Table Data Provided]
questions.text_english: Using the following data, analyse the sectoral contribution of India and Pakistan towards Gross Value Added (GVA). [Table Data Provided]

key_points: Agriculture contribution: Pakistan (24%) > India (16%).
Industry contribution: India (30%) > Pakistan (19%).
Service sector: Pakistan (57%) > India (54%).
Overall: India is more industrially advanced, while Pakistan remains more agriculturally dependent.

questions.solution: The data indicates a significant difference in the economic structure of India and Pakistan. Pakistan has a higher contribution from the agricultural sector (24%) compared to India (16%), reflecting higher dependence on agriculture. Conversely, India demonstrates a stronger industrial base with a 30% contribution to GVA, while Pakistan's industry contributes only 19%. In the service sector, both nations have large contributions, with Pakistan at 57% and India at 54%, illustrating the transition towards service-oriented economies in both countries.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित गद्य को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए: चीन ने अपनी अर्थव्यवस्था को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए कईं नीतिगत परिवर्तन किए थे। 1970 के दशक के अंत में विभिन्न क्षेत्रों में चीन की आर्थिक वृद्धि तीव्र रही थी। हालाँकि, भारत को अपने आर्थिक परिवर्तन के लिए बहुत प्रतीक्षा करनी पड़ी थी। भारत की महत्त्वपूर्ण आर्थिक प्रगति 1991 के आर्थिक सुधारों के उपरांत ही प्राप्त की गई थी, जिन्हें मज़बूरी के कारण लागू किया गया था। दिए गए गद्य व सामान्य ज्ञान के आधार पर, चीन व भारत द्वारा आरंभ किए गए सुधारों के प्रभावों की तुलना कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Read the following text carefully: China underwent substantial policy changes to stimulate their economy. China's economic growth was rapid in the late 1970s across various sectors. However, India had to wait much longer for its economic transformation. India's significant economic progress was only realised after the economic reforms of 1991, which were implemented out of compulsion. On the basis of given text and common understanding, compare the impact of subsequent reforms initiated by China and India.

key_points: China's reforms (late 1970s) focused on gradual liberalization and industrialization, leading to sustained high growth.
India's reforms (1991) were 'compelled' by crisis, focusing on liberalization, privatization, globalization (LPG).
Result: China achieved faster industrial growth and poverty reduction; India saw faster service sector growth.

questions.solution: China's economic reforms, initiated in the late 1970s, were proactive and focused on gradual liberalization and attracting foreign investment, which resulted in rapid and sustained industrial growth over several decades. In contrast, India's significant reforms in 1991 were reactive, triggered by a severe balance-of-payments crisis. While China prioritized manufacturing to become the 'factory of the world,' India's reforms shifted its focus toward liberalization, privatization, and globalization, which led to a robust services-led growth model. Both countries successfully reduced poverty, but the trajectory and sectoral focus of their economic transformations have differed significantly.

questions.text: (क) (i) मानव पूँजी व भौतिक पूँजी के मध्य अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए। (ii) धारणीय विकास को परिभाषित कीजिए। अथवा (ख) (i) ग्रामीण भारत में सूक्ष्म-साख कार्यक्रम के महत्त्व पर संक्षेप में वर्णन कीजिए। (ii) भारत में धारणीय विकास प्राप्त करने में सम्मिलित किसी एक रणनीति का उल्लेख कीजिए।
questions.text_english: (a) (i) Distinguish between human capital and physical capital. (ii) Define Sustainable Development. OR (b) (i) Describe briefly the importance of micro-credit programmes in Rural India. (ii) State any one strategy involved in attaining sustainable development in India.

sub_questions.text: (i) मानव पूँजी व भौतिक पूँजी के मध्य अंतर।
sub_questions.text_english: (i) Difference between human and physical capital.

key_points: Physical: Tangible (machines, buildings).
Human: Intangible (skills, knowledge, health) embedded in individuals.

sub_questions.solution: Physical capital refers to tangible assets like machinery, buildings, and infrastructure used in the production process. Human capital, on the other hand, refers to the intangible stock of skills, knowledge, experience, and health embodied within the individuals, which contributes to their productive potential.

key_points: Development that meets needs of the present without compromising ability of future generations to meet their needs.

sub_questions.solution: Sustainable development is defined as a form of development that meets the needs of the present generation without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.

questions.solution: This question addresses fundamental concepts of human capital and sustainable growth strategies in the context of Indian rural development and environment policies.

questions.text: मान्य तर्कों द्वारा, उल्लेख व विस्तृत व्याख्या कीजिए कि निम्नलिखित कथन सत्य हैं या असत्य: (क) भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था ने हाल ही के वर्षों में, कार्यबल के औपचारीकरण की दिशा में संतोषजनक प्रगति दर्शाई है। (ख) भारतीय ग्रामीण परिदृश्य में, कृषि विविधीकरण आय के अंतर को पाटने के लिए एक उचित विकल्प के रूप में उभरा है।
questions.text_english: State and elaborate whether the following statements are true/false, with valid arguments: (a) The Indian economy has shown satisfactory progress towards formalization of workforce in the recent years. (b) In the Indian rural landscape, agricultural diversification has emerged as a reasonable alternative to fill up the gaps in income.

key_points: False: A large portion of the Indian workforce is still informal.
Reason: Despite policy initiatives, the shift to formal sector jobs remains slow and challenging.

sub_questions.solution: This statement is generally considered false. While the government has implemented various policies to promote formal employment, a significant majority of the Indian workforce continues to be engaged in the informal sector, which lacks job security, social protection, and formal contracts. The pace of formalization has been relatively slow.

key_points: True: Diversification helps reduce reliance on volatile seasonal agriculture.
Reason: Non-farm activities provide stable income sources.

sub_questions.solution: This statement is true. Agricultural diversification towards higher-value crops and non-farm activities is a crucial strategy. It helps farmers reduce their dependence on single, seasonal crops, lowers risks associated with climate variability, and creates stable, supplemental income sources, thereby narrowing the income gap in rural areas.

questions.solution: These questions analyze current trends in workforce structure and rural livelihoods in India.

questions.text:
(क) (i) "आयात प्रतिस्थापन नीति को, यदि सावधानी से लागू नहीं किया गया, तो यह किसी भी अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए दुधारी तलवार साबित हो सकती है।" क्या आप दिए गए कथन से सहमत हैं? मान्य तर्कों द्वारा अपने उत्तर की पुष्टि कीजिए। (ii) उल्लेख कीजिए कि बहुपक्षीय व्यापार किस प्रकार द्विपक्षीय व्यापार से भिन्न है।
अथवा
(ख) (i) भारत में आर्थिक सुधारों के दौरान प्रारंभ किए गए कर सुधारों के कारणों व परिणामों पर संक्षेप में चर्चा कीजिए। (ii) भारत में सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र की नवरत्न व महारत्न कंपनी का एक-एक उदाहरण दीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) (i) "Import substitution policy, if not applied carefully, can be a double-edged sword for any economy." Do you agree with the given statement? Justify your answer with valid arguments. (ii) State how multilateral trade is different from bilateral trade.
OR
(b) (i) Discuss briefly the causes and consequences of tax reforms initiated during economic reforms in India. (ii) Give one example each of a Navratna and a Maharatna company in the public sector in India.

key_points: Agree: Double-edged sword.
Positive: Protects infant industries.
Negative: Can lead to inefficiency, lack of competition, higher prices, and low-quality goods for consumers.

sub_questions.solution: I agree that import substitution is a double-edged sword. While it effectively protects 'infant industries' from international competition, allowing them to grow and build capacity, it can also lead to significant inefficiencies. Lack of foreign competition often results in domestic firms producing low-quality goods at higher costs, causing consumers to suffer from limited choices and high prices, and stifling the innovation that stems from competitive pressure.

sub_questions.text: (ii) बहुपक्षीय व्यापार व द्विपक्षीय व्यापार में अंतर।
sub_questions.text_english: (ii) Difference between multilateral and bilateral trade.

key_points: Bilateral: Trade between two countries.
Multilateral: Trade involving more than two countries, often through agreements like WTO.

sub_questions.solution: Bilateral trade occurs exclusively between two countries through trade agreements that cover specified goods and services. Conversely, multilateral trade involves more than two countries and is typically governed by international trade organizations like the World Trade Organization (WTO), promoting broader trade relationships and global trade rules.

questions.solution: This question evaluates understanding of trade policies, including protectionism (import substitution) versus free trade mechanisms, and fiscal reforms.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित गद्य को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए: (1) श्रम बल भागीदारी दर (LFPR) किसी राष्ट्र में कार्यरत अथवा सक्रिय रूप से रोज़गार की तलाश कर रहे व्यक्तियों के प्रतिशत को मापती है। भारत में, 2000-2019 के मध्य श्रम बल में 99.2 मिलियन व्यक्तियों की वृद्धि हुई थी। श्रम बल 396.3 मिलियन से बढ़कर 495.5 मिलियन हो गया था।

(2) 2012-2019 के दौरान, रोज़गार में समान वृद्धि के बिना श्रम बल में हुई वृद्धि से बेरोज़गारी में बढ़ोतरी हुई थी।

(3) भारत के श्रम बाज़ार में लैंगिक असमानता उल्लेखनीय है, 2022 में महिलाओं की श्रम बल भागीदारी दर (LFPR) 32.8% है, जो कि पुरुषों की श्रम बल भागीदारी दर (LFPR) 77.2% से काफी कम है। यह भारत की समग्र अल्प श्रम बल भागीदारी दर (LFPR) का एक प्रमुख कारण है, जो कि वैश्विक औसत श्रम बल भागीदारी दर (LFPR) 47.3% से कम है।

(4) 2000-2019 के दौरान, ग्रामीण श्रम बल भागीदारी दर (LFPR) में 14.1% की गिरावट आई है, जबकि शहरी क्षेत्रों में 3.5% की गिरावट आई थी। 2019-2022 के मध्य यह प्रवृत्ति पलट गई, ग्रामीण श्रम बल भागीदारी दर (LFPR) में 6% (विशेषकर ग्रामीण महिलाओं में) और शहरी श्रम बल भागीदारी दर (LFPR) में 2.1% वृद्धि हुई। ये परिवर्तन दर्शाते हैं कि महिलाओं की श्रम बाज़ार भागीदारी में उतार-चढ़ाव होता है, विशेषकर ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में।

(5) इसने समग्र श्रम बल भागीदारी दर (LFPR) को काफी प्रभावित किया है। महिलाएँ आर्थिक कठिनाइयों के दौरान कार्यबल में शामिल होती हैं, तथा जब परिस्थितियों में सुधार होता है, तो वे कार्यबल से निकल जाती हैं।
questions.text_english:
Read the following text carefully: (1) The Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) measures the percentage of the population either employed or actively seeking employment in a nation. In India, the labour force grew by 99.2 million persons between 2000-2019. The labour force grew from 396.3 million to 495.5 million.

(2) During 2012-2019, the labour force grew without a matching increase in employment, leading to higher unemployment.

(3) The gender disparity in India's labour market is notable with women's LFPR at 32.8% in 2022, significantly lower than men's LFPR at 77.2%. This is a major reason for India's overall low LFPR, which is lower than the global average of 47.3%.

(4) During 2000-2019, rural LFPR declined by 14.1%, compared to a 3.5% decline in urban areas. This trend reversed between 2019-2022, with rural LFPR increasing by 6% (especially among rural women) and urban LFPR by 2.1%. These shifts suggest that fluctuations occur in women's labour market participation, particularly in rural areas.

(5) This significantly affected the overall LFPR. Women join the workforce during economic hardships and move out when conditions improve.

key_points: A situation where individuals are willing and able to work at the prevailing wage rate but are unable to find employment.

sub_questions.solution: Unemployment is defined as a situation where individuals who are actively looking for work and are willing to work at the current market wage rate are unable to find suitable employment.

sub_questions.text: श्रम बल भागीदारी दर (LFPR) का अर्थ लिखिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Write the meaning of Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR).

key_points: LFPR is the proportion of the population that is either employed or actively looking for work.

sub_questions.solution: The Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) represents the percentage of the population that is part of the labour force, meaning those who are either currently employed or actively seeking employment in the economy.

sub_questions.text: 2000-2019 के दौरान ग्रामीण व शहरी श्रम बल भागीदारी दर (LFPR) में लैंगिक असमानताओं पर टिप्पणी कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Comment upon the gender disparities in rural and urban Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) during 2000 - 2019.

key_points: Significant decline in rural LFPR (14.1%) compared to urban (3.5%).
Gender disparity is a major cause for low overall LFPR.
Women's participation fluctuates significantly, especially in rural areas, linked to economic conditions.

sub_questions.solution: During 2000-2019, the rural LFPR experienced a much steeper decline (14.1%) than urban LFPR (3.5%). A major contributor to this trend and the overall low LFPR in India is the significant gender disparity, as reflected in the low participation of women in the labour market compared to men. Paragraph (4) and (5) of the text highlight that women's participation, particularly in rural areas, is highly susceptible to fluctuations based on prevailing economic conditions.

questions.solution: This passage-based question examines the student's ability to analyze data related to labour market participation, unemployment, and gender disparity in the Indian context.
